scope: Optimization of full Dixon-Lewis transport including Soret, compared with the preserved code after the previous HPC campaign. Local descriptive measurements, no universal speed guarantee.

full_comparison.scope: Warm native solve timings; baseline process precedes candidate. Same inputs, no continuation seeds. Exact arrays checked; differences reported without relaxing solver acceptance.

trailing_control.scope: Warm native solve timings; baseline process precedes candidate. Same inputs, no continuation seeds. Exact arrays checked; differences reported without relaxing solver acceptance.

alternating_face_and_jacobian_micro.scope: Seven alternating samples on identical saved converged states, actual independent baseline kernels and selected production kernels. Four range workers, BLAS1, compilation and byte comparison outside timing. Jacobian includes a base face pass.

profile_before.scope: Single diagnostic sample per case; all inclusive timers reset after compile_kernels, captured at solve_diffusion_problem return. Nested categories overlap. Warmup not measured. No performance change measured.

profile_after.scope: Single diagnostic sample per case; all inclusive timers reset after compile_kernels, captured at solve_diffusion_problem return. Nested categories overlap. Warmup not measured. No performance change measured.

baseline_face_phase_diagnostic.scope: Separate sequential warmed diagnostic batches; 96 sampled real converged faces, seven samples with three traversals. Not full-solver cost fractions; no compilation included.

phase_diagnostic_note: Only typed-list v2 used; reflected-list initial trial rejected due to argument-conversion overhead.

standalone_flux_experiments.scope: Warmed independent ordered accumulator variants; prepacked matrix cost excluded, only valid for coefficients reused across many columns.

schur_lu_experiments.limits: Warm local face kernels only; no flame or end-to-end CH4-MS claim. Scratch matrices 0/1 and vector 11 are dead, not preserved.

experiment_limitations: Schur/LU exploratory measurements may overlap compilation/test work and are not the authoritative whole-solver evidence. Production LU adds threshold/layout fallback; final tests and alternating actual-source micro validate selection.

static_work_avoided.note: Static work/array payload counts, not measured cache misses, memory bandwidth or RSS.
